definitions.name: learning.propose
definitions.description: Enqueue scene-scoped learning supported by currently available nonbot sources. queued is not saved: processing happens independently after foreground work. Simulation never saves learning. Specify subject self only for an actual cited self-statement, mentioned only with the exact canonical personId and zero-based original message parts index, or unresolved without a personId. Nicknames, quotes, jokes and hypotheses do not establish a self-fact; third-party reports remain claims. Never infer personality or gender. Unknown event/validity times must stay omitted; observedAt and source snapshots are server-owned. Relation extraction is disabled. Do not propose relations or infer graph endpoints; ordinary sourced memory extraction remains available. Plan tracking is disabled; do not include commitment commands. Structured knowledge extraction is disabled; do not include knowledge proposals, source spans or guessed entities.

definitions.name: learning.propose
definitions.description: Enqueue scene-scoped learning supported by currently available nonbot sources. queued is not saved: processing happens independently after foreground work. Simulation never saves learning. Specify subject self only for an actual cited self-statement, mentioned only with the exact canonical personId and zero-based original message parts index, or unresolved without a personId. Do not erase these qualifiers to seek automatic admission: only asserted/current can be considered for the separate low-risk admission policy, and even accepted does not mean verified truth. Reported statements remain candidate claims, not verified truth. Do not assume automatic acceptance or invent graph endpoints. Plan tracking is disabled; do not include commitment commands. Structured knowledge extraction is disabled; do not include knowledge proposals, source spans or guessed entities.

definitions.description: Enqueue scene-scoped learning supported by currently available nonbot sources. queued is not saved: processing happens independently after foreground work. Specify subject self only for an actual cited self-statement, mentioned only with the exact canonical personId and zero-based original message parts index, or unresolved without a personId. A valid span only proves where text occurs, not that its meaning supports your predicate or that the claim is true. Use literal text, number with explicit unit or null for unknown unit, or boolean only when the registered predicate permits it. depends_on connects concept/task entities only, not arbitrary literals. Never combine knowledge with publicTechnicalDomain: structured claims remain scene-private and are not public-review material. Knowledge does not upgrade old relations or commitment confirmations. Do not treat a queued or proposed structure as saved or accepted.
